child_bin.description: Absolute path to the claude binary to run. Unset searches PATH.

default_account.description: Account to select when --account is absent. Unset falls through to the last-used marker.

default_profile.description: Profile to compose when --profile is absent. Unset composes nothing.

auto_trust_cwd.description: Record the directory a launch starts in as trusted, in that terminal's own session directory. Set false to answer claude's workspace-trust prompt yourself.
